subject.title: [Feature]: Multi-gateway support in the mobile apps: paired-gateway registry, quick switching, per-gateway credential scoping

question: Should maintainers sponsor first-class multi-gateway support in the official mobile apps now, and should it land as coordinated iOS/Android registry work or staged per-platform slices?
rationale: The feature is aligned with companion-app priorities, but the permanent shape affects mobile credential storage, migration, UI, push relay, watch, voice, and session-state boundaries.

options.title: Approve coordinated registry design
options.body: Define the shared invariants first, then land iOS and Android slices that preserve identical credential and active-gateway semantics.

options.title: Stage one platform first
options.body: Let iOS or Android implement the registry first with explicit follow-up tracking for parity and shared-kit adjustments.

options.title: Defer registry work
options.body: Keep the current single-pairing model plus per-gateway cache/outbox groundwork until maintainers prioritize mobile multi-gateway UX.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated registry design
recommendation.body: Define the shared invariants first, then land iOS and Android slices that preserve identical credential and active-gateway semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the issue and has the strongest recent history across the mobile gateway state, credential, cache, and outbox surfaces.
